events.input: $ grep -o 'href="[^"]*"' /tmp/idx.html | head -3; for p in $(grep -o 'href="[^"]*"' /tmp/idx.html | sed 's/href="//;s/"$//' | sort -u); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} " "http://localhost:8883/wt-review/$p"; done; echo; grep -o 'href="[^"]*"' /tmp/idx.html | sort -u | wc -l

events.input: $ grep -oE "(src|href)=['\"][^'\"]*" /tmp/idx.html | head -5; grep -oE "<a [^>]{0,120}" /tmp/idx.html | head -3; grep -oE "[a-z-]+/index\.html" /tmp/idx.html | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '
